title: Cardinal Billing Account Installment Invoice: Premium Portion and Installment Charge
content:
**Computation clause.** Each installment of the current term of a Cardinal Billing Account after the down payment is invoiced the pay plan's invoice lead days (calendar days) before its due date. Its premium portion follows the installment schedule: the premium of the term not yet invoiced, which is the term premium plus additional premium less return premium received for the term, less the premium of the installments already invoiced, is divided evenly over the installments of the term not yet invoiced and rounded to the cent, the last installment taking whatever remains. The installment charge is the pay plan's installment fee. The installment charge is never below zero and is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Quantities

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Installments in the term | One plus the result of the package's term months divided by the pay plan's installment interval, less one |
| Installments not yet invoiced | Installments in the term, less the installments of the term already invoiced (the down payment included) |
| Premium of the term not yet invoiced | Term premium, plus additional premium, less return premium received for the term, less the premium of the installments already invoiced |
| Premium portion | Premium not yet invoiced divided by the installments not yet invoiced, rounded to the cent; for the last installment, the whole premium not yet invoiced |
| Installment charge | The pay plan's installment fee |

The package's term months are those of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package the account bills.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A six-month term on a monthly plan has one plus (6 divided by 1, less one), that is 6 installments. The term premium received is $1,200.00, additional premium $60.00 and return premium $0.00. Installments 1 to 3 have been invoiced with premium of $600.00 in all.

- Premium not yet invoiced: $1,200.00 plus $60.00, less $600.00, that is $660.00.
- Installments not yet invoiced: 6 less 3, that is 3.
- Premium portion of installment 4: $660.00 divided by 3, that is $220.00.
- With a plan installment fee of $8.00, the invoice carries $220.00 of premium and an installment charge of $8.00.

When installment 6 is invoiced it is the last; its premium portion is whatever premium of the term then remains not yet invoiced.
